title: Playdough Letter Factory
shareTitle: Playdough Letter Factory — Roll, Shape, and Spell
description: Choose a bright dough color, roll it with real swipes, trace giant uppercase letters, build picture words, and make free-form clay art in a warm stop-motion factory.
learningGoals: Practice the motor sequence and direction of uppercase letter strokes
Connect printed letters with their sounds and familiar picture words
Assemble three-letter words in order with a concrete picture clue
Explore pressure-free fine-motor mark making and symbol stamping
interactionModel: large color choices, repeated horizontal swipes, forgiving guided path tracing, tap-or-drag letter placement, and free pointer drawing
feedbackModel: dough stretches and pops under the finger; correct actions fill tactile progress beads; wrong starts wiggle gently and replay a spoken cue; completed letters come alive with a phonics card and confetti

modes.title: Build a Word
modes.skill: ordered letter assembly with a picture clue
